joaps-consultoria.title: 10 Companies Migrated with AI, a More Remote Operation and More Sales with a Lean Team
joaps-consultoria.subtitle: How Joaps Consultoria used Orbit to organize operations, serve more clients remotely and generate financial results with a team of only 4 people
joaps-consultoria.challenge: I knew I needed to organize the operation better, serve more remotely and gain scale, but that required a clear decision: migrate clients to a tool that made sense for them and for how we work. The challenge was not just buying a platform. It was leading that change strategically.
joaps-consultoria.solution:
When I saw Orbit, I understood it made a lot of sense for my clients and that the migration had to be led with conviction.
Instead of presenting the system as an optional choice, I showed the tool, explained the path and made it clear that this would be the next step in our operation.
From there I organized the change with a schedule for onboarding, training and guidance, so clients understood how to use the tool and how it would become part of the service routine.
joaps-consultoria.results:
Even with a team of only 4 people, we migrated 10 companies onto the platform at once, keeping operations live and support running.

In a short time we started seeing financial results, because the tool let us sell more and serve more remotely.

We also saw a clear improvement in internal organization, support capacity and results delivered to clients.
joaps-consultoria.testimonial:
My experience was 100% positive, but what made the difference was the decision.
When I saw the system, I understood it made a lot of sense for my clients. So I did not treat it as an option. I showed the tool and said: team, we need to move to this. I think that is why the process was not hard. It is simply a matter of having a strategy for how you will do it. Today we are already selling more because I have a tool that makes it possible to serve more remotely. We are also getting the house in order, because I can take on more clients without stopping serving the ones we already have.
I have already seen financial return, very good results inside our clients, and we are only at the beginning. We still have many clients to run and put on the platform, and we will do that soon.

templum-consultoria.title: Almost Double the Service Capacity with AI, More Recurrence and a Frictionless Client Experience
templum-consultoria.subtitle: How Templum used Orbit to eliminate loose documents and raise productivity from 1 consultant for 50 companies to nearly 100
templum-consultoria.challenge:
Before Orbit we had two big challenges.
The first was the client experience. They received the consulting, but still had to execute much of the guidance in spreadsheets, loose documents and almost offline processes. That made the journey heavier and added friction to implementation.
The second was recurrence. We already succeeded in sales and project delivery, but at the end of the journey even satisfied clients had no clear structure that justified continuing the consulting.
We lacked a model that kept value alive after the main delivery.
templum-consultoria.solution:
With Orbit, the operation was centralized on an intelligent platform.
The client stopped depending on scattered files and started executing activities on screen, in an organized journey that is smoother and easier to follow.
That also changed the recurrence logic. Consulting stopped being seen only as a project with a beginning, middle and end, and started working as a continuous operation with permanent value for the client.
templum-consultoria.results:
Service productivity increased significantly.
Before, the average was already high, with about 1 consultant serving 50 companies. Now we are approaching 1 consultant for 100 companies — almost doubling that capacity.
Monthly recurring revenue also started growing faster than projected, driven by faster and more positive client adoption.
Engagement improved too. With everything inside the platform, it became easier to keep the client active, following the journey and consuming the consulting more naturally and continuously.
templum-consultoria.testimonial:
The transformation Orbit brought to Templum is spectacular. Today we are a more modern company, aligned with the market and with a solution fully grounded in artificial intelligence.
Before, the client received the consulting but still had to execute a lot in spreadsheets, loose documents and almost offline processes. With Orbit we removed that friction and made the experience much more fluid and immediate.
For us the big challenge was keeping clients recurring after the project ended. Now, because everything lives inside software with intelligence, the client has a reason to stay.
Productivity also changed a lot. We already had a high average of 1 consultant serving about 50 companies, and now we are getting close to 1 for 100. Monthly recurring revenue is also growing at a speed we had not even projected.
The most important thing is seeing client interest and engagement. Today they want to continue, they want to come back, because it became better to consume what we deliver. Consulting became more enjoyable to consume.

cortex-malharia.title: From Hands-On Consulting to a Proprietary AI Platform for the Textile Sector
cortex-malharia.subtitle: How Cortex Malhar.IA turned its consulting method into a white-label platform, configuring new client environments in two clicks
cortex-malharia.challenge: We had a solid consulting method, Retilínea Desenvolvimento de Malharias, with a well-defined ideal client profile and a management model validated for knitting mills and textile industries. The challenge was scaling that method without losing quality and without depending on a slow, manual implementation for every new client. We needed a platform that was ours, with our brand and identity, and that could deliver our method already configured from the client's first login.
cortex-malharia.solution: Through Orbit we created Cortex Malhar.IA: our own consulting platform, with logo, name, visual identity, payment gateway, plans, discount coupons, checkout and sales page configured entirely under our brand. Inside the platform we built consulting agents specific to the textile sector, with departments, roles, processes, hiring models, training and CRM modeled on our ideal client profile.
cortex-malharia.results: We turned our consulting method into a scalable platform with its own identity. Implementation that used to take hours of manual work now happens in two clicks, delivering more value from day one. We also acquired a stock of licenses at a reduced, lifetime cost, which puts us at a competitive advantage versus new consultants.
cortex-malharia.testimonial: Orbit is helping my consulting firm a great deal. I already have a batch of clients on Orbit and others about to join, and I picked up extra licenses because the more licenses, the lower the cost, and that cost becomes lifetime. The real differentiator is delivering a lot already filled in for the client, who then adapts — that values our knowledge base. When a new client comes in, with two clicks I configure their environment based on my method. I see that as our competitive advantage.

grupo-gsn.title: R$200,000 Saved and Fully Connected Management
grupo-gsn.subtitle: How Grupo GSN replaced every management tool with Orbit and connected strategy to operations with integrated AI Agents
grupo-gsn.challenge: At Grupo GSN we operated with several separate tools — ClickUp, Trello and Pipedrive — each in a department, with no integration between them. Besides the high cost, fragmentation kept AI from having enough context to be truly useful. We also needed to connect strategic management to operations: planning, sales, finance and people worked in silos.
grupo-gsn.solution: Orbit centralized all of our management on a single platform. With everything in the same environment, AI agents started operating with full context, which was impossible with information scattered across isolated tools. Integration between the sales funnel, finance and activities connected, for the first time, the strategic view to day-to-day execution. In HR, for example, a job description is already born connected to our strategic plan, mission, values and culture.
grupo-gsn.results: We cut more than R$200,000 per year in tools alone. With everything centralized, our areas started working in an integrated way and AI agents gained the context they need to support decisions across the operation.
grupo-gsn.testimonial: Orbit is a Ferrari. We are falling more in love with it every day. We had several tools — ClickUp, Trello, Pipedrive — and we really replaced all of them with a single powerful tool that helped us cut more than R$200,000 in yearly spend. And it has what the other tools do not: powerful agents. For artificial intelligence, context matters a lot. When you have a bunch of disconnected tools in each department, you cannot contextualize the AI. Inside Orbit, everything is connected. We definitely cannot live without it anymore.

Right after adopting the platform we opened a role and completed the entire process in less than two weeks, from opening to hiring. In that period the People Agent reviewed more than 300 resumes and helped us reach the ideal candidate with more speed and confidence.
At the same time, in daily operations we were able to remove friction from the routine, with clearer follow-up of activities and more fluid process organization. Orbit has been meeting our needs in strategic areas and adding value to our internal processes.
crs-residuos.testimonial:
CRS Resíduos e Saúde's experience with the Orbit platform has been very satisfactory, especially in HR, in recruiting and selecting new team members. The tool has brought more practicality, organization and strategic support to the selection process, helping identify important points in candidate analysis that could go unnoticed in a purely human evaluation.
Orbit also contributes to more objective screening, extracting relevant information about professional profile, behavior and alignment with the company's needs. That brought more clarity and structure to evaluations and hiring decisions.
Beyond HR, the platform is also used for project management, tasks and Kanban organization, helping follow activities. Overall, Orbit has been meeting CRS's needs in strategic areas, especially recruiting and operational organization, adding value to internal processes and company management.

That is how Potencialize positioned itself as a channel of channels: I help the accountant structure their clients' management better, the accountant delivers more value at the edge, and both sides win with a more efficient, organized and profitable operation.

Because the accountant sells accounting, but many companies do not have the organization needed to keep a correct operation. That is why today I see myself as a channel of channels.
That strategy was fundamental for me, because besides helping the accountant, the accountant also makes money from it.
Today we have about 14 clients using Orbit and around 6 sub-channels. At Potencialize we are already seeing a lot of management results, with things working better and processes done in a simpler, faster way.
Our clients are also being monetized from this, and we also win by having that access and being a channel of channels.

With it we eliminated software, cut costs, quickly pivoted the company to AI-powered management and opened the US market. In a few days of active selling we already had closed deals, proposals on the table and a much more scalable margin. Orbit is changing Weagle's story!
